user.title: Connect to Two Spoons
user.description: Enter your Two Spoons site address and an API token for Home Assistant.

data_description.url: Your Two Spoons site address, starting with https://
data_description.api_token: The Home Assistant token created for your household

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter API token
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {host} was rejected. Enter a new one.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Two Spoons
reconfigure.description: Change the site address or token. Leave the token blank to keep the current one.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach Two Spoons. Check the URL and your connection.
error.blocked_by_firewall: Blocked by the Vercel firewall. Try again later.
error.invalid_url: Enter a web address starting with http:// or https://

abort.already_configured: This Two Spoons site is already set up.

data_description.poll_minutes: How often to fetch the lists. Changes made from Home Assistant refresh straight away.

invalid_auth.message: Two Spoons rejected the API token. Re-enter it to continue.

blocked_by_firewall.message: Two Spoons is blocked by the Vercel firewall. Try again later.

no_shopping_week.message: Two Spoons has no shopping week right now.

ready_meal_read_only.message: Ready Meals days can be ticked here, but only renamed or removed in Two Spoons.

ready_meal_day_not_removed.message: 1 Ready Meals day wasn't removed: {items}. Ready Meals days can only be removed in Two Spoons.

ready_meal_days_not_removed.message: {count} Ready Meals days weren't removed: {items}. Ready Meals days can only be removed in Two Spoons.

item_not_found.message: That item no longer exists in Two Spoons.

not_loaded.message: Two Spoons isn't set up or isn't loaded.

invalid_item.message: Two Spoons couldn't add that item. Try saying it again, more briefly

unknown_store.message: Two Spoons has no store with the code {store}. The codes are {codes}

unknown_store_code.message: Two Spoons has no store with the code {store}

choose_entry.message: More than one Two Spoons is set up. Choose one with config_entry_id

add_item_invalid_auth.message: Two Spoons rejected Home Assistant's token, so nothing was added. Re-enter the token in Home Assistant

add_item_blocked_by_firewall.message: Two Spoons is blocking Home Assistant for now, so nothing was added. Try again later

add_item_no_shopping_week.message: Two Spoons has no shopping week right now, so nothing was added

add_item_timeout.message: Two Spoons took too long to answer. The item may still have been added, so check the list before trying again

add_item_cannot_connect.message: Something went wrong talking to Two Spoons. Check the list to see whether the item was added

add_item_rejected.message: Two Spoons couldn't add that item ({code})

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Fetches the shopping lists from Two Spoons now.

add_item.name: Add item
add_item.description: Adds an item to a Two Spoons list, the way Quick Add does. With no store, Two Spoons picks one from the text.

item.name: Item
item.description: The item as spoken, for example "2 litres of milk".

store.name: Store
store.description: A store code such as FP or WW. Leave empty to let Two Spoons choose.

config_entry_id.name: Two Spoons entry
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Two Spoons is set up.

blocked_by_firewall.title: Two Spoons is blocked by the Vercel firewall
blocked_by_firewall.description: Requests from Home Assistant to Two Spoons were challenged by the site's firewall. Home Assistant will try again in 15 minutes; this notice clears itself once a request gets through. If it keeps happening, check the firewall rule that lets the Home Assistant API through.
